title: "04 - Player Comparisons"
author: "Hunter Clark"

This notebook compares recorded speed buildup among players sharing a published official 40 time within a Combine position and draft year.

## Setup

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gganimate)

ROOT <- normalizePath(getwd())

while (!(dir.exists(file.path(ROOT, "analysis_r")) &&
         dir.exists(file.path(ROOT, "data")))) {

  parent <- dirname(ROOT)

  if (parent == ROOT) {
    stop("Open the project folder first.")
  }

  ROOT <- parent
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = ROOT)
```

## Load the profile handoff

```{r load-profiles}
handoff_path <- file.path(
  ROOT,
  "outputs",
  "r_restart",
  "03_consistency",
  "profile_handoff.rds"
)

if (!file.exists(handoff_path)) {
  stop("Complete and save 03_profile_consistency.Rmd first.")
}

profiles <- readRDS(handoff_path)

player_roster <- profiles$player_roster
attempt_keys <- profiles$attempt_keys

profiles$peak_decisions
```

## Choosing the comparison

```{r comparison-settings}
POSITION <- "WR"
DRAFT_YEAR <- "2023"

# Leave NA to select the official time shared by the most players
# in the selected position and year.
FORTY_TIME <- NA_real_

# Leave NULL to display up to four players from that time group.
# Alternatively, enter player IDs as text:
# PLAYER_IDS <- c("55939", "56118")
PLAYER_IDS <- NULL
```

## Preparing official results

```{r official-results}
comparison_roster <- player_roster |>
  mutate(
    official_forty_s = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(forty)
    )
  )

if (any(!is.finite(comparison_roster$official_forty_s)) ||
    any(comparison_roster$official_forty_s <= 0)) {
  stop("Review missing, unreadable, or nonpositive official 40 results.")
}

if (any(
  abs(
    comparison_roster$official_forty_s * 100 -
      round(comparison_roster$official_forty_s * 100)
  ) > 1e-6
)) {
  stop("Review official times reported beyond hundredth-second precision.")
}

comparison_roster <- comparison_roster |>
  mutate(
    official_forty_hundredths = as.integer(
      round(official_forty_s * 100)
    )
  )
```

## Available same-time groups

```{r same-time-groups}
position_year_roster <- comparison_roster |>
  filter(
    combine_position == POSITION,
    draft_year == DRAFT_YEAR
  )

if (nrow(position_year_roster) == 0L) {
  stop("No players match the selected position and draft year.")
}

available_groups <- position_year_roster |>
  count(
    official_forty_hundredths,
    name = "players"
  ) |>
  filter(players >= 2L) |>
  mutate(
    official_forty_s = official_forty_hundredths / 100
  ) |>
  arrange(
    desc(players),
    official_forty_hundredths
  )

available_groups
```

## Players selection

```{r players-selection}
if (nrow(available_groups) == 0L) {
  stop("No exact official-time group contains at least two players.")
}

if (is.na(FORTY_TIME)) {

  selected_time_hundredths <- first(
    available_groups$official_forty_hundredths
  )

} else {

  if (!is.finite(FORTY_TIME) ||
      FORTY_TIME <= 0 ||
      abs(FORTY_TIME * 100 - round(FORTY_TIME * 100)) > 1e-6) {
    stop("Enter a positive official time at hundredth-second precision.")
  }

  selected_time_hundredths <- as.integer(
    round(FORTY_TIME * 100)
  )
}

eligible_players <- position_year_roster |>
  filter(
    official_forty_hundredths == selected_time_hundredths
  ) |>
  arrange(
    display_name,
    nfl_id
  )

if (is.null(PLAYER_IDS)) {

  selected_players <- eligible_players |>
    slice_head(n = 4)

} else {

  if (anyDuplicated(PLAYER_IDS) > 0L ||
      length(setdiff(PLAYER_IDS, eligible_players$nfl_id)) > 0L) {
    stop("Player IDs must be unique and belong to the selected comparison group.")
  }

  selected_players <- eligible_players |>
    filter(nfl_id %in% PLAYER_IDS)
}

if (nrow(selected_players) < 2L ||
    nrow(selected_players) > 4L) {
  stop("Choose between two and four eligible players.")
}

selected_players |>
  select(
    display_name,
    nfl_id,
    draft_year,
    combine_position,
    nfl_position,
    official_forty_s,
    ten_yd_split,
    recordings
  )
```

## Prepare individual recording curves

```{r individual-recording-curves}
comparison_curves <- profiles$forties |>
  semi_join(
    selected_players,
    by = c("draft_year", "nfl_id")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    selected_players |>
      select(
        draft_year,
        nfl_id,
        display_name
      ),
    by = c("draft_year", "nfl_id"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) |>
  group_by(across(all_of(attempt_keys))) |>
  arrange(timestamp, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    recording_time_s = round(
      as.numeric(
        difftime(
          timestamp,
          first(timestamp),
          units = "secs"
        )
      ),
      digits = 6
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

selected_peaks <- profiles$named_peaks |>
  semi_join(
    selected_players,
    by = c("draft_year", "nfl_id")
  )

peak_frame_values <- comparison_curves |>
  select(
    all_of(attempt_keys),
    recording_time_s,
    s
  ) |>
  rename(
    peak_time_from_recording_start_s = recording_time_s,
    speed_at_peak_raw = s
  )

peak_markers <- selected_peaks |>
  left_join(
    peak_frame_values,
    by = c(
      attempt_keys,
      "peak_time_from_recording_start_s"
    ),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    peak_type = if_else(
      peak_at_search_boundary,
      "Boundary peak",
      "Interior peak"
    )
  )

if (anyNA(peak_markers$speed_at_peak_raw)) {
  stop("An observed peak could not be matched to its tracking frame.")
}
```

## Comparing recorded speed buildups

```{r compare-recorded-buildups, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
speed_comparison_plot <- ggplot(
  comparison_curves,
  aes(
    x = recording_time_s,
    y = s,
    colour = display_name,
    linetype = factor(attempt),
    group = interaction(nfl_id, event_id, attempt)
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(
    data = peak_markers,
    aes(
      x = peak_time_from_recording_start_s,
      y = speed_at_peak_raw,
      colour = display_name,
      shape = peak_type
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Interior peak" = 16,
      "Boundary peak" = 17
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Same official forty, different recorded speed buildup",
    subtitle = paste0(
      DRAFT_YEAR,
      " Combine ",
      POSITION,
      " | Official 40: ",
      sprintf("%.2f", selected_time_hundredths / 100),
      " s"
    ),
    x = "Seconds since first recorded frame",
    y = "Supplied speed (raw units)",
    colour = "Player",
    linetype = "Attempt label",
    shape = "Observed acceleration maximum",
    caption = paste(
      "All selected recordings shown. Points mark seven-frame acceleration peaks.",
      "Recording start is not verified physical launch.",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

speed_comparison_plot
```

## Compare curves relative to an observed speed crossing

```{r crossing-references}
comparison_references <- profiles$named_intervals |>
  semi_join(
    selected_players,
    by = c("draft_year", "nfl_id")
  ) |>
  select(
    all_of(attempt_keys),
    status,
    lower_crossing_s
  )

comparison_references |>
  count(
    status,
    name = "recordings"
  )

if (any(comparison_references$status != "Measured") ||
    anyNA(comparison_references$lower_crossing_s)) {
  stop(
    "A selected recording lacks the crossing reference. Retain the recording-start comparison."
  )
}

aligned_curves <- comparison_curves |>
  left_join(
    comparison_references |>
      select(
        all_of(attempt_keys),
        lower_crossing_s
      ),
    by = attempt_keys,
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    time_from_speed_crossing_s =
      recording_time_s - lower_crossing_s
  )

aligned_peaks <- peak_markers |>
  left_join(
    comparison_references |>
      select(
        all_of(attempt_keys),
        lower_crossing_s
      ),
    by = attempt_keys,
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    peak_time_from_speed_crossing_s =
      peak_time_from_recording_start_s - lower_crossing_s
  )

if (anyNA(aligned_curves$lower_crossing_s) ||
    anyNA(aligned_peaks$lower_crossing_s)) {
  stop("A recording could not be matched to its crossing reference.")
}
```

```{r plot-crossing-aligned-speed, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
crossing_aligned_plot <- ggplot(
  aligned_curves,
  aes(
    x = time_from_speed_crossing_s,
    y = s,
    colour = display_name,
    linetype = factor(attempt),
    group = interaction(nfl_id, event_id, attempt)
  )
) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dotted",
    colour = "gray50"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(3, 7),
    linetype = "dotted",
    colour = "gray70"
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(
    data = aligned_peaks,
    aes(
      x = peak_time_from_speed_crossing_s,
      y = speed_at_peak_raw,
      colour = display_name,
      shape = peak_type
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Interior peak" = 16,
      "Boundary peak" = 17
    )
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(-0.25, 1.25)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Speed buildup from an observed crossing",
    subtitle = paste0(
      DRAFT_YEAR,
      " Combine ",
      POSITION,
      " | Shared published 40: ",
      sprintf("%.2f", selected_time_hundredths / 100),
      " s"
    ),
    x = "Seconds relative to observed 3-unit speed crossing",
    y = "Supplied speed (raw units)",
    colour = "Player",
    linetype = "Attempt label",
    shape = "Observed acceleration maximum",
    caption = paste(
      "Reference is the lower crossing used in the measured 3–7 interval.",
      "It is not physical launch. Peak estimates and boundary flags are unchanged.",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

crossing_aligned_plot
```

The selected players’ speed curves become more closely aligned when time is referenced to their observed 3-unit speed crossing. This illustrates the sensitivity of recording-start comparisons to the timing reference. Differences remain in the measured intervals and individual recordings.

## Peak timing under alternative references

```{r compare-peak-time}
aligned_peak_table <- aligned_peaks |>
  select(
    display_name,
    attempt,
    peak_acceleration_raw_per_s,
    peak_time_from_recording_start_s,
    peak_time_from_speed_crossing_s,
    peak_type
  ) |>
  arrange(
    display_name,
    as.numeric(attempt)
  )

print(aligned_peak_table, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

Among four 2023 Combine WRs sharing a published 4.54-second 40, observed peak timing depends on the selected reference. Interior peaks occur approximately 0.05–0.17 seconds after the observed 3-unit speed crossing. Two additional maxima fall at the supported-region boundary. The recordings illustrate differences in observed acceleration profiles, but do not establish precise launch-relative timing or a stable player ranking.

## Animation

```{r animation}
replay_root <- normalizePath(getwd())

handoff_relative <- file.path(
  "outputs",
  "r_restart",
  "04_comparisons",
  "comparison_handoff.rds"
)

while (!file.exists(file.path(replay_root, handoff_relative))) {
  parent <- dirname(replay_root)

  if (parent == replay_root) {
    stop(
      "Open the R project containing ",
      "comparison_handoff.rds before running this code."
    )
  }

  replay_root <- parent
}

comparison <- readRDS(
  file.path(replay_root, handoff_relative)
)

replay_output <- file.path(
  replay_root,
  "outputs",
  "r_restart",
  "04_comparisons",
  "animations"
)

dir.create(
  replay_output,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

keys <- c(
  "draft_year",
  "event_id",
  "nfl_id",
  "entity_type",
  "drill_name",
  "attempt"
)

# Prepare each recording.
frames <- comparison$recording_start_curves |>
  left_join(
    comparison$selected_players |>
      select(
        draft_year,
        nfl_id,
        official_forty_s
      ),
    by = c("draft_year", "nfl_id"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) |>
  group_by(across(all_of(keys))) |>
  arrange(timestamp, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    dx = last(x) - first(x),
    dy = last(y) - first(y),
    net = sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2),

    forward_displacement_raw = (
      (x - first(x)) * dx +
        (y - first(y)) * dy
    ) / net
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(
    display_name,
    as.numeric(attempt),
    recording_time_s
  ) |>
  mutate(
    frame_id = as.integer(
      round(recording_time_s / 0.1)
    ),

    recording_label = paste(
      display_name,
      "| Attempt",
      attempt
    )
  )

# Check required measurements.
if (
  any(!is.finite(frames$forward_displacement_raw)) ||
  anyNA(frames$official_forty_s) ||
  any(
    abs(
      frames$recording_time_s -
        frames$frame_id * 0.1
    ) > 1e-6
  )
) {
  stop(
    "Review positions, official results, ",
    "or the 0.1-second time grid."
  )
}

if (anyDuplicated(frames[c(keys, "frame_id")])) {
  stop("Duplicate recording/frame keys.")
}

# Assign a separate lane to each attempt.
lane_labels <- rev(
  unique(frames$recording_label)
)

frame_ids <- seq.int(
  min(frames$frame_id),
  max(frames$frame_id)
)

frames <- frames |>
  mutate(
    lane = match(
      recording_label,
      lane_labels
    )
  )

lanes <- frames |>
  distinct(
    recording_label,
    display_name,
    attempt,
    official_forty_s,
    lane
  ) |>
  arrange(lane) |>
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      recording_label,
      "\nPublished 40: ",
      sprintf("%.2f s", official_forty_s)
    )
  )

recordings <- frames |>
  group_by(across(all_of(keys))) |>
  group_split(.keep = TRUE)

# Build moving points and recent movement trails.
point_parts <- list()
trail_parts <- list()

for (k in frame_ids) {
  for (g in recordings) {
    available <- g |>
      filter(frame_id <= k)

    if (nrow(available) == 0L) {
      next
    }

    current <- available |>
      slice_tail(n = 1)

    ended <- k > max(g$frame_id)

    current <- current |>
      mutate(
        animation_frame = factor(
          k,
          levels = frame_ids
        ),

        state = if (ended) {
          "Recording ended"
        } else {
          "Observed frame"
        },

        clock_label = if (ended) {
          sprintf(
            "Tracking ends: %.1f s",
            recording_time_s
          )
        } else {
          sprintf(
            "%.1f s",
            recording_time_s
          )
        },

        speed_label = if (ended) {
          sprintf("last speed %.1f", s)
        } else {
          sprintf("speed %.1f", s)
        }
      )

    point_parts[[length(point_parts) + 1L]] <- current

    recent <- available |>
      filter(
        frame_id >= max(available$frame_id) - 5L
      ) |>
      mutate(
        animation_frame = factor(
          k,
          levels = frame_ids
        )
      )

    trail_parts[[length(trail_parts) + 1L]] <- recent
  }
}

replay_points <- bind_rows(point_parts)
replay_trails <- bind_rows(trail_parts)

# Locate the saved acceleration peaks.
peak_positions <- comparison$crossing_aligned_peaks |>
  select(
    all_of(keys),
    peak_time_from_recording_start_s,
    peak_type
  ) |>
  mutate(
    frame_id = as.integer(
      round(
        peak_time_from_recording_start_s / 0.1
      )
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    frames |>
      select(
        all_of(keys),
        frame_id,
        forward_displacement_raw,
        lane,
        display_name
      ),
    by = c(keys, "frame_id"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  )

if (anyNA(peak_positions$forward_displacement_raw)) {
  stop("A peak could not be located.")
}

peak_history <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    frame_ids,
    function(k) {
      peak_positions |>
        filter(frame_id <= k) |>
        mutate(
          animation_frame = factor(
            k,
            levels = frame_ids
          )
        )
    }
  )
)

# Player colors.
player_names <- sort(
  unique(frames$display_name)
)

base_colors <- c(
  "#5EE6F2",
  "#FFC46B",
  "#D4B2FF",
  "#F9F477"
)

player_colors <- setNames(
  rep(
    base_colors,
    length.out = length(player_names)
  ),
  player_names
)

distance_max <- max(
  frames$forward_displacement_raw
)

distance_min <- min(
  frames$forward_displacement_raw
)

same_official <- unique(
  frames$official_forty_s
)

official_header <- if (length(same_official) == 1L) {
  paste0(
    "Published 40: ",
    sprintf("%.2f s", same_official),
    "  |  "
  )
} else {
  "Published 40s listed beside players  |  "
}

# Decorative football-field markings.
turf_bands <- tibble(
  xmin = seq(
    0,
    distance_max,
    by = 10
  ),

  xmax = pmin(
    xmin + 5,
    distance_max + 1
  )
)

field_lines <- tibble(
  x = seq(
    0,
    distance_max,
    by = 5
  )
)

field_hashes <- expand.grid(
  x = seq(
    1,
    floor(distance_max),
    by = 1
  ),

  y = seq(
    0.75,
    length(lane_labels) + 0.25,
    by = 1
  )
)

# Create the animation with larger text.
replay_plot <- ggplot(
  replay_points,
  aes(
    x = forward_displacement_raw,
    y = lane,
    colour = display_name,
    group = recording_label
  )
) +
  geom_rect(
    data = turf_bands,
    aes(
      xmin = xmin,
      xmax = xmax,
      ymin = 0.55,
      ymax = length(lane_labels) + 0.45
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "#286940",
    colour = NA
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 0,
    xmax = distance_max + 1,
    ymin = 0.55,
    ymax = length(lane_labels) + 0.45,
    fill = NA,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = field_lines,
    aes(
      x = x,
      xend = x,
      y = 0.55,
      yend = length(lane_labels) + 0.45
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.55,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = field_hashes,
    aes(
      x = x - 0.12,
      xend = x + 0.12,
      y = y,
      yend = y
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_path(
    data = replay_trails,
    linewidth = 1.4,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = peak_history,
    aes(
      x = forward_displacement_raw,
      y = lane,
      colour = display_name,
      shape = peak_type
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.8,
    fill = "#185532",
    stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = state),
    size = 5,
    stroke = 1.3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = speed_label),
    nudge_y = 0.26,
    hjust = 0.3,
    size = 6.2,
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = distance_max + 11,
      label = clock_label
    ),
    colour = "white",
    size = 5.8,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = distance_max + 11,
    y = length(lane_labels) + 0.65,
    label = "Tracking clock",
    size = 6,
    colour = "white",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = player_colors,
    limits = player_names,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Observed frame" = 16,
      "Recording ended" = 1,
      "Interior peak" = 23,
      "Boundary peak" = 24
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = lanes$lane,
    labels = lanes$label
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(
      0,
      floor(distance_max / 10) * 10,
      by = 10
    )
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(
      min(-1, distance_min - 1),
      distance_max + 21
    ),

    ylim = c(
      0.45,
      length(lane_labels) + 0.95
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Same Forty, Different Gears",

    subtitle = paste0(
      official_header,
      "Elapsed recording time: ",
      "{sprintf('%.1f', as.numeric(current_frame) / 10)} s"
    ),

    x = paste(
      "Recorded forward displacement from first location",
      "(raw coordinate units)"
    ),

    y = NULL,

    caption = paste(
      paste(
        "Field styling is illustrative;",
        "distance remains in raw coordinate units.",
        "Published 40 is a player-level result."
      ),

      paste(
        "The tracking clock starts at the first recorded frame,",
        "not verified launch.",
        "Tracking ends does not mean the runner stopped."
      ),

      paste(
        "Numbers by dots are supplied speed (raw units).",
        "Hollow circles mark ended recordings;",
        "diamonds/triangles mark interior/boundary observed peaks."
      ),

      sep = "\n"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#FAFBFD",
      colour = NA
    ),

    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#185532",
      colour = NA
    ),

    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    text = element_text(
      colour = "#18344F"
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 17,
      lineheight = 1.1
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 17
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 13,
      margin = margin(t = 12)
    ),

    legend.position = "none",

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 27
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 25,
      margin = margin(t = 8, b = 18)
    ),

    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 10,
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(t = 16)
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      20, 25, 18, 20
    )
  ) +
  transition_manual(animation_frame)

# Render the recorded 0.1-second steps.
frame_dir <- file.path(
  replay_output,
  "field_replay_frames"
)

dir.create(
  frame_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

png_files <- animate(
  replay_plot,
  nframes = length(frame_ids) + 10L,
  fps = 10,
  width = 1600,
  height = 1000,
  device = "png",
  end_pause = 10,
  renderer = file_renderer(
    dir = frame_dir,
    prefix = "frame_",
    overwrite = TRUE
  )
)

# Save the GIF.
gif_file <- file.path(
  replay_output,
  "selected_forty_replay_field.gif"
)

gifski::gifski(
  png_files = png_files,
  gif_file = gif_file,
  width = 1600,
  height = 1000,
  delay = 0.1,
  loop = TRUE,
  progress = FALSE
)

# Save a still preview around one second.
preview_index <- which(
  frame_ids == min(10L, max(frame_ids))
)[1]

preview_file <- file.path(
  replay_output,
  "selected_forty_replay_field_preview.png"
)

file.copy(
  png_files[preview_index],
  preview_file,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# Show published times and recording durations.
recording_times <- frames |>
  group_by(recording_label) |>
  summarise(
    published_forty_s = first(official_forty_s),
    observed_duration_s = max(recording_time_s),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(recording_times, width = Inf)

cat(
  "\nSaved GIF to:\n",
  normalizePath(gif_file),
  "\n"
)

# Display when knitting the Rmd.
knitr::include_graphics(gif_file)
```
